guitar.notes: Confirmed — Billie Joe Armstrong's battered Fernandes "Blue" guitar is extremely well documented as his main guitar for decades.

tone.target: tight dry punk-pop crunch with bright upper mids
tone.profile: tight dry punk-pop crunch with bright upper mids
tone.summary: A classic punk-pop chain using a Green OD boost into a UK 45 amp model, paired with the UK Vintage 4x12 cab for bright, dry crunch and clarity.
